title: docs(plugins): `plugin-view.mdx:399` authors a ViewFilter `operator` in the spec's DEPRECATED camelCase alias spelling (`lessThan`) — canonical is `less_than`
body:
Found while working objectui#7971 (PM loop R45, `domain:devx` seat). Filed unassigned; ⛔ NOT fixed there — different page, different governing type, outside that card's scope fence (that card's own premise turned out to be false for its two lines, see below).

## Measured on `origin/main` at `36fc746` (2026-09-06)

```
content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx:399   filter: [{ field: 'price', operator: 'lessThan', value: 100 }],
```

Unlike objectui#7971's `lookupFilters` (which type-checks against this repo's own, unrelated `LookupFilterDef.operator` union — see that issue's closing report for why its premise was false), this `filter:` block on `plugin-view.mdx` is a genuine `@objectstack/spec` `ViewFilter`. Measured by importing the shipped spec's `./ui` subpath export in this repo's `node_modules` (the root `.` export does not carry these symbols):

```js
const spec = require('@objectstack/spec/ui'); // resolves to .../@objectstack/spec/dist/ui/index.js
spec.VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES.lessThan   // 'less_than'
spec.normalizeFilterOperator('lessThan')     // 'less_than'
spec.VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS.includes('lessThan')  // false
spec.VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS.includes('less_than') // true
```

`lessThan` is a deprecated camelCase alias per `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATOR_ALIASES`'s own doc comment: "Deprecated: new producers MUST emit the canonical forms; these aliases are a migration bridge and may be dropped in a future major." A documentation example is a new producer.

## ⚠️ Before fixing, verify this page's `filter:` block actually type-checks against a type that carries `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS`

objectui#7971 taught the expensive lesson that a docs page authoring something that *looks* like a spec-operator value is not proof it is checked against that spec's type — verify with `pnpm check:doc-snippets` (or by tracing the block's declared type) which real type governs `plugin-view.mdx`'s `filter:` key before assuming the canonical-spelling swap is even valid here, the same way the `lookupFilters` swap was invalid on `lookup.mdx` / `user.mdx`.

## Suggested repair (docs only, mechanical, IF the above verification confirms it)

`operator: 'lessThan'` → `operator: 'less_than'`. No prose change. Verify with `pnpm check:doc-snippets` and `pnpm check:doc-types`.

Related: objectui#7971 (adjacent alias-spelling class, premise false for `lookupFilters`), objectui#7713 (same class, `object-grid.filter`), objectui#7972 (same underlying "unannotated literal, enum never consulted" mechanism).
